# Write Outreach

Compose and revise individual professional messages with genuine substance and the author's authentic voice.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Use to draft, edit or review founder emails, one-to-one pitches, LinkedIn DMs, freelance enquiries, introductions, reconnections and follow-ups.

Example request:

> Use the research and our earlier conversation to draft a genuine email to the founder. Don't turn it into a templated pitch.

Expected result: A recipient-specific message grounded in real discoveries and relationship context, without invented familiarity, compulsory calls to action or generic sales scaffolding.

## A concrete example

This illustrative example starts from the source facts below.

**Source facts and constraints:** An established contact has previously discussed developer integrations with the author. A recent independent example demonstrates a product capability. The author has not personally tested the integration.

**Before**

> Hello, I am impressed by your innovative platform. I recently tested your solution and would love to pick your brain about synergy.

**After**

> That integration we discussed came to mind when I saw a customer using the shared-session API in a classroom app. Interesting how far beyond browser demos it goes. Have you seen other teams take it in that direction?

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.9.1 --skill write-outreach
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/write-outreach/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/write-outreach/references/outreach-writing.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.

## Practices behind this skill

Adapts Anthropic Outreach Composer and Mangosteen POV alongside Geekist's writing principles. Emphasises relationship history, evidence-led observations, first-person truth, and transferable editorial lessons from authorised author corrections.

- [Anthropic Outreach Composer](https://github.com/anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins/blob/main/small-business/skills/outreach-composer/SKILL.md)
- [Mangosteen POV](https://github.com/Mangosteen-Studio/pov/blob/main/SKILL.md)
- [Geekist marketing writing](https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/blob/main/skills/write-marketing-content/SKILL.md)

The [source-to-guidance map](../../standards/framework-evidence.md) explains how these sources inform the skill and which decisions are local.
